experiment_data.hypothesis: Different LLMs (Llama-4-Maverick, Qwen3-235B, DeepSeek-Chat) produce systematically different confusion matrices on the same classification tasks, and these empirical confusion matrices can be used to quantify annotation error propagation in downstream causal inference.

spec.model_name: Llama 4 Maverick (meta-llama/llama-4-maverick), Qwen 3 235B (qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b), DeepSeek Chat V3 (deepseek/deepseek-chat)
spec.combinations: 3 datasets x 3 models x 3 prompts = 27 runs
spec.launch_method: nohup (3rd attempt, previous tmux/ssh sessions killed by SIGHUP)
